author: hattrill
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PANTHER:PTN000211242
NEUROLYSIN, MITOCHONDRIAL (PTHR11804:SF44)
* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
* e.g. UniProtKB:Q91YP2
* GO:0005758 mitochondrial intermembrane space

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
* Neurolysin was originally characterised as a mitochondrial intermembrane space protein but subsequent studies have found it to be localised to the mitochondrial matrix. This is consistent with the N-terminal mitochondrial targeting sequence and its role.
* I have removed the underlying annotation from UniProtKB:P42676
* Added GO:0005759 mitochondrial matrix  IDA to UniProtKB:Q91YP2 from PMID:29183787

Note that the [PROTEASE M3 THIMET OLIGOPEPTIDASE-RELATED](https://pantherdb.org/panther/family.do?clsAccession=PTHR11804) subfamilies have different localizations: 

THIMET OLIGOPEPTIDASE (PTHR11804:SF50) - cytosol
(just made annotation to UniProtKB:P52888 IDA PMID:29183787 to cytosol)

and
[MITOCHONDRIAL INTERMEDIATE PEPTIDASE (PTHR11804:SF79)](https://pantherdb.org/panther/family.do?clsAccession=PTHR11804:SF79) is mitochondrial matrix
title: PAINT issue:PANTHER:PTN000211242
